checks: Ctrl+backslash creates independent groups without replacing the existing editor
same-file edits and undo synchronize; Ctrl+S saves the focused group
Ctrl+Tab switches files inside the focused group and returns keyboard focus there
Quick Open and toolbar save target their group; other file remains unchanged
split down creates rows; closing a group keeps its unsaved document
restart restores editor groups, selected files and unsaved text
closing the last dirty view asks before discarding
narrow layout fits; joining releases the extra editor without losing text
native right-click tab menu splits the selected file and focuses its new group
numbered shortcuts focus visual groups, create the next empty group, preserve it on restart and route Quick Open there
command palette group navigation restores keyboard focus to the chosen editor
native tab submenu moves an unsaved file into an empty group, preserves draft text and undo/redo, and saves the correct file
palette moves to an existing group without duplicate tabs; restart restores moved membership and the empty source group
editor toolbar submenu offers the same keyboard-accessible move action
scope: Linux Electron source build, real CodeMirror instances and temporary files/drafts. Agent discovery disabled. No native Windows/macOS or installer verification.

validation.limits: Linux source Electron with virtual X display; no native Windows/macOS, installer or release certification.
